_comment: End-to-end pre-LLM pipeline against the live deploy: a task message that should match the seeded 'investigate-failure' procedure. Steps 2-8 run for real (ClassifyRequest + RoutingWorkflow + SkillDiscover + ComposeSkill, all real activities/model calls); only the reason-act loop itself is scripted. Verifies SkillDiscover stages kind='skill' rows, ComposeSkill stages kind='composed' AND seeds turn_plan (cp1..cpN), the scripted plan_progress calls advance those seeded checkpoints, and RecordSkillOutcome writes a skill_candidates row at turn end.

message.content: Debug why the nightly integration build has failed for three consecutive days across the api, worker, and scheduler services. Reproduce it, find the shared root cause, implement the fix, and add a regression test so it can't recur.

scripted_model_responses.content: Root cause: a shared integration test fixture has a race that surfaces under CI load, failing both services non-deterministically. Fix: make the fixture set-up idempotent and scope it per-test.
